parsed.post: Warning: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes shard 10, which is EVAL_SHARD — that's training on the validation set. The ~0.95 numbers are data leakage, not real gains. I'm discarding my own 0.953 run; please keep shards '0-9'. Also discarded MLR 0.10 (1.128 worse). Next: probing MLR 0.06.
parsed.description: MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.06 on clean baseline (shards 0-9); bracketing LR since 0.10 regressed
parsed.report_to_operator: Data-leakage alert: agent-0's widely adopted TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' change trains on shard 10, which is the fixed eval shard (EVAL_SHARD=10). That makes reported val_bpb (~0.95) an artifact of memorizing validation data, not generalization. I discarded my own contaminated run and reverted to shards '0-9'; please advise whether leakage-based configs should be disqualified team-wide.
